difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies that the homotopy category of the differential graded category of Situation ABC satisfies TR1, TR2 and TR3 (statement lines 4495-4500). H2: the constituent lemmas are cited, but the assembly with sign bookkeeping is the argument and cannot be replaced by any single reference.
